name: Klia Store
tagline: Browse, install and manage your Flatpak applications
blurb: Klia Store is a modern, fast application store built specifically for managing Flatpak applications on Linux.
description:
Klia Store is a modern, fast application store built specifically for managing Flatpak applications on Linux. Beyond browsing and installing apps, it gives you tools to keep your system organized and under control.

Features:

• Browse, install and update Flatpak applications, all from one place

• Back up and restore your installed applications, including their data and runtimes

• Visualize your installed apps and their permissions (storage, camera, file access) in an interactive view

• Audit installed apps by verifying their source manifest against Flathub, helping protect against supply-chain tampering

• Review requested permissions and a risk assessment before installing a local .flatpak file

• Available in multiple languages, with automatic detection of your system language

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
